name: Gruagach
description: Highland magician of a tradition older than the Order of Hermes whose magic revolves around Exceptional Talents; may be sponsored by House Ex Miscellanea.

name: Highland Sailor
description: Grog template: a former galley crewman from the western coast now serving a covenant ashore.

name: Ghillie
description: Grog template: a sixteen-year-old young man of a clan eager to prove himself on raids.

name: Clansman
description: Grog template representing the typical armed Highland clansman and herdsman.

name: Gallowglaigh
description: Grog template: a Hebridean mercenary trained to attack at a run in heavy chain armor, veteran of Irish wars.

name: Border Rider
description: Grog template: a mounted cattle raider from the Borders wanted by the English.

name: Lowland City Militiaman
description: Grog template: a woodworker from a Lowland city trained to wield the spear.

name: Lowland Merchant
description: Companion template: a calculating, obese Lowland merchant who secretly acts as a front for magi.

name: Bard/Olamh
description: Companion template: a traveling poet, teacher and musician welcome for his news and songs.

name: Monk of the Scottish Church
description: Companion template: a monk of the Scottish Church who left his monastery after it was annexed to the Cistercians.

name: Highland Chieftain
description: Companion template: chief of a sept responsible for forty families, embroiled in a blood feud.

name: Cailleach Glioc
description: Companion template: an elderly Highland wise woman who makes small potions and amulets with conditions attached.

name: Ex Miscellanea Storm Witch
description: Magus template: a Highland weather witch who calls or dispels storms by whistling, disdained by other Hermetic magi.

name: Quaesitor Investigator
description: Magus template: a newly initiated Quaesitor seeking to cleanse the Loch Leglean Tribunal without real authority.

name: Ex Miscellanea Shapeshifter
description: Magus template: a feral magus who takes the forms of wolf, goat, hare, raven and golden eagle.

name: Highland Weather Witch
description: Tradition of Highland witches able to call or dispel storms by whistling.

name: Brude Deathless
description: Crotchety gruagach over 550 years old, son of Damhan-allaidh, living in a broch in the far North; the most powerful human known in Scotland, who casts Geasa on his apprentices to ensure they train students.

name: Damhan-allaidh
description: Ancient spider-like gruagach enemy of the Order who warred against Pralix; after defeat in 890 he fled to the Shetlands and may return to conquer Scotland.

name: Pralix
description: Hermetic leader whose forces fought Damhan-allaidh, separated at the battle of Loch Oadh.

name: Donald Dubh
description: Young gruagach used as an example of learning new Exceptional Talents such as Magic Sensitivity and Transform.

name: Chearlach
description: Gruagach used in the newid gornest example, taking bird form to escape Brude's lava.

name: MacBeth
description: One of the last Scottish kings, contending with Malcolm Canmore around 1050-1060.

name: Lulach
description: With MacBeth, one of the last Scottish kings before Malcolm Canmore.

name: Malcolm Canmore
description: Scottish king who brought a continental court and feudalism to Scotland and invaded northern England in 1070.

name: William the Conqueror
description: Norman king of England who retaliated against Malcolm Canmore's invasion in 1071-72.

name: Margaret, Maid of Norway
description: Heir whose death in 1290 left the Scottish throne vacant.

name: King Edward of England
description: English king asked to adjudicate the Scottish succession after 1290.

name: John Balliol
description: King chosen by Edward of England who proved unpopular, sparking rebellions.

name: William Wallace
description: The most successful Scottish rebel of the 1290s, whose fortunes are tied to Horsingas.

name: Malcom Ceann Dubh
description: Son of the chief and tanist of a clan, leader of a cattle drive to Aberdeen.

name: Sean Beg
description: Ringleader of the clansmen who raid another clan's herd during the drive to Aberdeen.

name: King Alexander I
description: Scottish king who appointed Henry de Goulis seneschal and made the title hereditary in 1121.

name: Henry de Goulis
description: Seneschal appointed by King Alexander I, ancestor of Lord Goulis.

name: David, Lord Goulis
description: Diabolist seneschal of the Scottish king who built Monksend castle, hunting souls in the Borders with his demonic familiar and demon dogs.

name: Robyn Redcap
description: Demonic familiar of Lord Goulis in the form of a redcap, who keeps his cap red with fresh blood and guards Monksend.

name: An Banrigh nam Eilan nam Crodh Beag
aliases: The Queen of the Island of Little Cattle
description: The Queen of the Island of Little Cattle, secretly a famhair a'falach in the Shetlands seeking her hidden heart so she can die.

name: Caitlin of Crun Clach
description: Major magus of the Loch Leglean Tribunal from the covenant of Crun Clach.

name: Calum Mac Lachlan
description: Major magus of Clan Mac Gruagach, portrayed as a more normal gruagach.

name: Whitburh Frithowebba
description: Major magus of Horsingas who grants investigators quaesitorial authority via seals.

name: Aonghus Mac Dughal
description: Notorious cattle thief killed by the clansman template character.

name: Kenneth MacAlpin
description: King whose conquest of Pictland led to the disappearance of the Pictish language.

name: St. Mungo
description: Saint whose Bell and Staff were carried north by a fleeing abbot.

name: Seumas Dubh
description: Cattle thief mentioned by the ghillie template.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House that sponsors gruagachan and hedge wizards; dominated by Diedne after the consolidation of Scotland.

name: House Diedne
description: House that dominated Scotland for a hundred years before being destroyed in the Schism War.

name: House Flambeau
description: House that fought Diedne in the Schism War and is hated by the Loch Leglean Tribunal.

name: House Tytalus
description: House that fought Diedne in the Schism War.

name: House Quaesitor
description: House of Hermetic investigators; fought Diedne in the Schism War.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Hermetic Order of magi, hated by Damhan-allaidh.

name: Ordo Miscellanea
description: Order of native magicians created after the war against Damhan-allaidh, later joining the Order of Hermes.

name: Clan Mac Gruagach
description: Clan descended from Brude Deathless, associated with the gruagach tradition.

name: Order of Odin
description: Rival magical order whose rumored activity Damhan-allaidh might spread.

name: Mac Peadars
description: Clan in long, deadly feud with a chief's clan in a story idea.

name: House of Canmore
description: Royal house of Scotland against which pretenders rebelled 1060-1189.

name: Praeses Septentrionalis
description: Opponent that Damhan-allaidh warred against, alongside Pralix.

name: Cistercians
description: Monastic order that established a chapter house and sought to annex a Scottish monastery.

name: Benedictines
description: Monastic order whose monastery lands were taken by David Goulis for Monksend.

name: Scottish Church
description: The native church of Scotland.

name: Picts
description: Ancient people of Scotland who spoke a language like Welsh; their culture vanished 840-900.

name: Vikings
description: Raiders attacking the north and west coasts of Scotland during the war against Damhan-allaidh.

name: Normans
description: Conquerors of England whose displaced Saxon nobles and magi fled north.

name: Scotti
description: Ancient people gruagachan might have fought.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: The Hermetic tribunal of Scotland.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose magi settled in the Lowlands and might protest aid to Wallace.

name: Norman Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose magi began settling in Scottish Lowlands around 1050-1060.

name: Horsingas
description: Covenant whose political fortunes rise and fall with William Wallace; home of Whitburh Frithowebba.

name: Crun Clach
description: Covenant of Caitlin; the Pact of Crun Clach of 1189 is named after it.

name: Pact of Crun Clach
description: 1189 agreement prohibiting Scottish magi from aiding in mundane politics.

name: Gruagach Magic
description: Verbal, personal magic based on Exceptional Talents, rolled with stress dice, affecting one target within earshot.

name: Newid Gornest
description: Gruagach shapeshifting duel used to settle arguments, as certamen serves the Order; the winner may cast a Geas or Curse on the loser.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic magical duel used to settle arguments, analog of the newid gornest.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Gruagachan gain Magic Resistance from their first three magical Talents instead of Parma Magica.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magical defense that gruagachan cannot learn.

name: Hermetic Magic
description: Magic of the Order of Hermes, contrasted with gruagach magic.

name: Dominion
description: Realm of the Divine; its Scottish temper benefits Hermetic magi but not gruagachan.

name: Scottish Temper of the Dominion
description: Special aura quality in Scotland whose benefits gruagachan cannot gain.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura modifiers apply to gruagachan as for Hermetic magi, but Magic auras don't aid gruagach learning.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power found in creatures such as giants and demons and in seaweed on an island near Brude's tower.

name: Aesfotedia
description: Substance found in demonic bodies such as Robyn Redcap and the demon dogs.

name: Twilight
description: Magi with Twilight points or near final Twilight experience dreams of Damhan-allaidh.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The law of the Order.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of Hermetic Law precedents.

name: Schism War
description: War 1003-1012 in which Diedne was destroyed by Flambeau, Tytalus and Quaesitor.

name: War Against Damhan-allaidh
description: War 810-816 of Pralix's forces and native magicians against Damhan-allaidh.

name: Battle of Loch Oadh
description: Battle where Pralix's forces were separated during the war against Damhan-allaidh.

name: Consolidation of Scotland
description: Period 840-900 when Pictish culture disappeared and Diedne ascended over Ex Miscellanea.

name: Norman Conquest of England
description: Conquest driving Saxon nobles and magi north into Scotland.

name: Geas
description: Magical compulsion cast by gruagachan; Brude's Geas requires apprentices to train a student by age forty-nine.

name: Curse
description: Gruagach Talent used to curse targets.

name: External Soul
description: Virtue allowing a gruagach or giant to separate the heart/soul from the body, granting +20 Magic Resistance and near-immortality.

name: Wizard's Sigil
description: Characteristic mark of a magus's magic.

name: Blood Feud
description: Highland clan feud escalating from insults to full-scale raids.

name: Cattle Raiding
description: Major part of Highland life in which clans lift each other's cattle, especially at summer's end.

name: Quarter Days
description: Imbolc, Beltane, Lughnasa and Samhain, the only days Damhan-allaidh may perform sacrifices.

name: Imbolc
description: Quarter day, Feb. 1.

name: Beltane
description: Quarter day, May 1.

name: Lughnasa
description: Quarter day, Aug. 1.

name: Samhain
description: Quarter day, Nov. 1.

name: Fairy Ring
description: Ring of the faeries, the subject of an anonymous verse warning against disturbing it.

name: Hell
description: Infernal power to which Lord Goulis owes obligation.

name: Magic Realm
description: Magic Might and magic auras relate to the Realm of Magic.

name: Gruagach Knowledge
description: Basic gruagach ability granted at character creation.

name: Gruagach Wisdom
description: Ability governing a gruagach's learning of new Exceptional Talents.

name: Gruagach Lore
description: Knowledge of gruagach tradition.

name: Shapeshift
description: Gruagach Talent to change one's own shape; the first Talent normally learned.

name: Transform
description: Special +3 gruagach Talent to change others' shapes; base Ease Factor 10.

name: Speak Pictish
description: Language ability added to gruagach casting totals.

name: Speak Gaelic
description: Language of the Highlands.

name: Speak Giant
description: Language used by famhairan a'falach in place of Speak Pictish for gruagach magic.

name: Potency
description: Ability added to gruagach casting totals.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: +1 Exceptional Talent for gruagachan.

name: Second Sight
description: Talent able to identify shapeshifted or transformed beings.

name: Sight of the True Form
description: Ability to identify shapeshifted beings.

name: Exceptional Talent
description: Class of abilities around which gruagach magic revolves.

name: Area Lore
description: Knowledge of a region.

name: Animal Handling
description: Skill needed for successful cattle raids (droving).

name: Stealth
description: Skill needed for cattle raids.

name: Enchanting Music
description: Exceptional Talent of music.

name: Entrancement
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Weather Sense
description: Talent to sense weather.

name: Faerie Sensitivity
description: Ability of magical giants.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic lab ability.

name: Hermes History
description: Knowledge of Hermetic history.

name: Hermes Lore
description: Knowledge of the Order.

name: Occult Lore
description: Knowledge of occult matters.

name: Hierarchy
description: Knowledge of demon names.

name: Will over Form
description: Ability to change into animal form.

name: Weather Affinity
description: Ability of the storm witch.

name: Finesse
description: Hermetic ability.

name: Penetration
description: Hermetic ability.

name: Hex
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Gift
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Geasa
description: Gruagach Talent of casting geasa.

name: Scribe Latin
description: Ability to write Latin.

name: Divination
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Premonitions
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Visions
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Dousing
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Sense Holy/Unholy
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Incinerate
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Creo and Rego Ignem, only for true fire; characteristic Presence.

name: Decay
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Perdo Animal and Corporem; characteristic Stamina.

name: Enthrall
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Rego and Perdo Mentem; used to take over minds of nobles, magi or churchmen.

name: Sacrifice
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Creo Vim; draining body levels from sacrifices on quarter days yields vis.

name: Shatter
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Perdo Herbam and Terram; characteristic Strength.

name: Magical Air
description: Flaw gained by gruagach on first botched magical Talent.

name: Offensive to Animals
description: Flaw gained by gruagach on first botched magical Talent.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Flaw gained by gruagach on second botch.

name: Giant's Blood
description: Virtue possessed by Brude Deathless.

name: Tough
description: Virtue giving thick skin.

name: Superior Demonic Familiar
description: Virtue of Lord Goulis.

name: Susceptible to Divine Power
description: Flaw of Lord Goulis.

name: Tainted with Evil
description: Flaw.

name: Dark Secret
description: Flaw.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Flaw marking a non-Hermetic practitioner.

name: Isolated from the Order
description: Flaw of the storm witch.

name: Independent Magic
description: Virtue.

name: Magical Affinity
description: Virtue.

name: Subtle Magic
description: Virtue.

name: Silent Magic
description: Virtue.

name: Quiet Magic
description: Virtue.

name: Extra Arts
description: Virtue.

name: Will over Form (Virtue)
description: Virtue allowing shapechange.

name: Personal Magic
description: Flaw.

name: Flawed Parma
description: Flaw.

name: Quaesitor (Virtue)
description: Virtue.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: Virtue.

name: Study Requirement
description: Flaw.

name: Susceptible to Infernal Power
description: Flaw.

name: True Faith
description: Virtue of the monk.

name: Clergy
description: Virtue.

name: Curse of Venus
description: Flaw of the bard.

name: Faerie Enmity
description: Flaw.

name: Ways of the Woods
description: Virtue.

name: Lack of Penetration
description: Flaw.

name: Hatred Passion
description: Virtue of Damhan-allaidh (Order of Hermes).

name: Need Not Sleep
description: Virtue.

name: Chaotic Magic
description: Flaw.

name: Vulnerability
description: Flaw (e.g. obsidian).

name: Fury
description: Flaw.

name: Exceptional Talent (Virtue)
description: Virtue granting an Exceptional Talent.

name: Close Family Ties
description: Virtue.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Virtue.

name: Leadership (Virtue)
description: Virtue.

name: Wealth
description: Virtue.

name: Geas (Flaw)
description: Flaw imposing a gruagach geas.

name: Obligation
description: Flaw.

name: Social Handicap
description: Flaw.

name: Palsied Hands
description: Flaw.

name: Poor Eyesight
description: Flaw.

description: Spell (ReAu 30) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Quiet the Raging Winds
description: Spell (PeAu 25) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Chaos of the Angry Wave
description: Spell (ReAq 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Circling Winds of Protection
description: Spell (ReAu 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Maintain the Demanding Spell
description: Spell (ReVi 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow
description: Spell (InAu 15) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Jupiter's Resounding Blow
description: Spell (ReAu 10) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Push of the Gentle Wave
description: Spell (ReAq 10) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: Spell (ReMe 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Ear for the Distant Voice
description: Spell (InIm 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Image from the Wizard Torn
description: Spell (ReIm 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Opening the Intangible Tunnel

description: Spell (InMe 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Wind of Mundane Silence
description: Spell (PeVi 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: The Unseen Arm
description: Spell (ReTe 5) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Cloak of Black Feathers
description: Spell (MuCo 35) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Cloak of Gilded Feathers
description: Spell (MuCo 35, golden eagle) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Shape of the Agile Climber
description: Spell (MuCo 25, goat) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Shape of the Moorland Runner
description: Spell (MuCo 25, hare) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Shape of the Woodland Prowler
description: Spell (MuCo 25) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Air's Ghostly Form
description: Spell (CrAu 5) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Steed of Vengeance
description: Spell effect treated as cast on Lord Goulis's demon horse.

name: Collect the Potency of Blood
description: Robyn Redcap's power (MuCo 15) to dip his cap in a victim's blood for +3 Str and Sta per Size point.

name: Howls of Confusion
description: Power (PeMe 15) of Lord Goulis's demon dogs that confuses victims, resisted by Int roll of 9+.

name: Lord Goulis's Armor
description: Enchanted armor gifted by his patron demon, giving Protection 16 and boosting his Strength, Dexterity and Quickness; vanishes if he dies.

name: Bell and Staff of St. Mungo
description: Relics carried north by a fleeing abbot rather than being handed to the bishop.

name: Silver Crucifix
description: Folk-belief holds one buried under the doorsill protects against Lord Goulis.

name: Rock of Eternal Life
description: Rock in Brude's tower said to make its owner live forever.

name: Shapechanging Powder
description: Powder in Brude's tower allowing the user to change shape without a spell.

name: Seal of Quaesitorial Authority
description: Seal Whitburh gives investigators granting quaesitoris authority for the dream investigation.

name: Famhair a'falach
description: Magical Highland giant up to forty feet tall with hidden heart (External Soul), originators of gruagach magic.

name: Famhair Laidir
description: Non-magical Highland giant up to 60 feet tall, dim-witted; many aided Damhan-allaidh.

name: Highland Giants
description: Nearly extinct race of giants in Sutherland and Strathnavar, in two kinds.

name: Crodh
description: Highland cattle, smaller and more intelligent than lowland cattle, which scatter when startled.

name: Lord Goulis's Demon Dogs
description: Demonic hounds (Might 8) accompanying Lord Goulis, with Howls of Confusion.

name: Demon Horse of Lord Goulis
description: Demon bound in horse form with fiery breath.

name: Redcap
description: Dark faerie who keeps his cap red with blood; form taken by Robyn.

name: Gearr
description: Hare, favorite form for Scottish shapechangers; blue mountain hare and brown hare.

name: Stoorworm
description: Highland monster that may ally with Damhan-allaidh.

name: Each Uisge
description: Highland water monster that may ally with Damhan-allaidh.

name: Unseelie Faeries
description: Dark faeries that could ally with Damhan-allaidh.

name: Dragon of the Pyrenees
description: Powerful creature used as a scale comparison with magical Highland giants.

name: Golden Eagle Messenger
description: Speaking golden eagle serving the Queen of the Island of Little Cattle.

name: Scotland
description: Land of the Loch Leglean Tribunal.

name: Highlands
description: Northern Scottish region of clans and gruagachan.

name: Lowlands
description: Southern Scottish region to which cattle are driven and where magi settled.

name: Shetland Islands
description: Islands where Damhan-allaidh fled after 890 and where the giant queen lives.

name: Sutherland
description: Remote region where the last Highland giants live.

name: Strathnavar
description: Remote region where the last Highland giants live; Navar River.

name: Aberdeen
description: Market town to which clan cattle are driven.

name: Dunkeld
description: Cattle market city with a large cathedral.

name: Monksend Castle
description: Castle built by David Goulis from 1187 on Benedictine monastery lands, reputed haunted.

name: The Borders
description: Region terrorized by Lord Goulis and home to border riders.

name: Teviot
description: River north of which Lord Goulis rarely hunts.

name: Annan
description: River west of which Lord Goulis rarely hunts.

name: Hermitage
description: Lands around which Lord Goulis has area lore.

name: Brude's Broch
description: Broch/tower in the far North on the northwest coast where Brude lives, near standing stones and a vis-rich island.

name: Galloway
description: Region where the monk wandered before finding the covenant.

name: Hebrides
description: Islands, home of gallowglaigh mercenaries.

name: Leinster
description: Irish region where the gallowglaigh fought.

name: Ireland
description: Land whence Gaelic came and where gallowglaigh served.

name: England
description: Kingdom to the south whose Normans and kings affected Scotland.

name: Pictland
description: Land of the Picts conquered by Kenneth MacAlpin.

name: Brittany
description: Region where Damhan-allaidh knows magical sites.

name: British Isles
description: Region where Damhan-allaidh knows magical sites.
